description: Erection of single storey rear/infill extension, first floor rear extension and change of roof profile over first floor side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Site Location Plan, XEVA/15SC/301 Rev A, XEVA/15SC/302 Rev A,  XEVA/15SC/303 Rev A, XEVA/15SC/304 Rev A, XEVA/15SC/307 Rev A , XEVA/15SC/308 Rev A received 16 January 2023; Fire Safety Statement received 23 January 2023; XEVA/15SC/305 Rev A, XEVA/15SC/306 Rev A received 16 February 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted.
